approval_timeout_seconds.description: Maximum time to wait for required local Windows approval.
approval_timeout_seconds.title: Approval Timeout Seconds

command.description: Exact noninteractive command/script to execute. Do not put file reads, searches, edits, or deletes here when a dedicated Codito tool can perform them.
command.title: Command

cwd.description: Project-relative cwd (empty=root), or absolute requested Windows directory.
cwd.title: Cwd

executor.description: Windows command interpreter used for command.
executor.title: Executor

idempotency_key.description: Caller-generated stable unique key for this logical mutation or command. Reuse only when retrying that exact same request.
idempotency_key.title: Idempotency Key

output_limit_bytes.description: Maximum combined stdout/stderr retained for this job.
output_limit_bytes.title: Output Limit Bytes

project_id.description: Opaque project ID returned by projects_list; never send a local path.
project_id.title: Project Id

purpose.description: Concise user-facing reason shown in Windows approval and local activity history.
purpose.title: Purpose

requested_external_paths.description: Absolute Windows paths the command is expected to access outside cwd/project, shown to local policy; this declaration never grants access.
requested_external_paths.title: Requested External Paths

start_wait_milliseconds.description: Initial server wait for completion/output before returning a job state.
start_wait_milliseconds.title: Start Wait Milliseconds

timeout_seconds.description: Maximum runtime before the process tree is stopped.
timeout_seconds.title: Timeout Seconds
